scope: Generation-only effect screen with speculation off. Prefill is setup, excluded from the scored time. Not a speed claim, predictor validation or quality check.

conditioning.prompt: How many minutes are in one hour? Give the number.
conditioning.source: retained profile-free bootstrap prompt; triggers the one-time post-prefill service calibration before placement

conditioning.prompt: Write a Python function count_initials(names) that ignores empty or whitespace-only strings and counts the first letter of each stripped name case-insensitively. Show one example.
conditioning.source: retained independent history prompt check-code; not a scored prompt

conditioning.prompt: Write a clear short explanation for new volunteers about labeling seed envelopes: include plant name, harvest month, and storage instructions. Keep a friendly tone and avoid unsupported shelf-life claims.
conditioning.source: retained independent history prompt check-prose; not a scored prompt

fixture.selection_rule: First 64 complete generation forwards of the coding light capture; prose only if coding ended before 64. Declared before any timing inspection.

standalone.note: The main series. Nsight and CUPTI libraries must be absent from the engine process.

trace.note: CUDA injection must exist at process start and learned state cannot cross processes, so the trace pair runs in its own load with its own bootstrap, placement, conditioning and origin. Both trace arms restore that process's origin. The pair is a separate diagnostic, not a matched continuation of the standalone load. Load time is reported separately; its setup counts against the warmed cap.

planned_executions.note: 22 executions is the count cap, and setup requests count toward it. The earlier total of 18 already included the standalone load's two conditioning requests. The second load's bootstrap and conditioning and the first load's bootstrap consume the former four-run reserve, so no follow-up run is available: an ambiguity stays unresolved. Helper-first placement and snapshot/restore operations are setup that count against the warmed cap, not against this run count.

classification.paired: material: every pair has the same sign and |d| >= band. bounded: every |d| < band and control drift < band. Otherwise unresolved.
classification.observational: Per replicate, value = exposed excess over matched current-work windows / generation time. material: all same sign with |v| - 2se >= band. bounded: all |v| + 2se < band, at least two replicates, coverage >= 0.5. Otherwise unresolved. These are associations, not causal prices.
classification.no_reserve: An effect the planned runs cannot resolve is reported as unresolved; no further run is available to settle it.

setup_note: Setup follows the retained procedure for the selected engine: profile-free bootstrap (calibration), helper-first placement from the independent demand history collected before this study, the two declared ordinary conditioning requests, then the learned-state snapshot. All generation in the study, including setup, has speculation off. The history profile was collected earlier under DSpark and seeds a frequency prior only; it is not regenerated here.
warmed_time_cap_note: The cap spans both loads and includes native setup, conditioning, placement and restores. Build and load times are reported separately.
